name: Twilight Pendant
summary: In Blackfathom Deeps, Twilight Pendants mark the cultists who serve the Twilight's Hammer. The Argent Dawn seeks them as proof of the cult's work along Ashenvale's coast.

sections.title: Tokens of the Old Gods
sections.body: Beneath the drowned ruins of Blackfathom Deeps, the Twilight's Hammer gathers with the naga to honor the chaotic Old Gods. Shadowmages, aquamancers, reavers, and loreseekers all wear Twilight Pendants as signs of devotion to their shadowy patrons. The cult keeps to the ruins of the former night elf temple, so these pendants offer outsiders one of the few ways to learn how many cultists gather there and hinder their plans.

sections.title: The Argent Dawn's Vigils
sections.body: Argent Guard Manados in Darnassus seeks Twilight Pendants as evidence that the growing darkness is being driven back. Blackfathom Deeps once held a pristine moonwell, and its desecration by void-worshipers threatens Kalimdor. Gathering the pendants shows that the Twilight's Hammer foothold in Ashenvale is being dismantled before its patrons can unleash greater terror.

faq.answer: Twilight Pendants are identifying amulets worn by the Twilight's Hammer in Blackfathom Deeps. They show the cultists' devotion to the Old Gods and their rites.

faq.q: Why does Argent Guard Manados want these pendants?
faq.answer: Argent Guard Manados seeks Twilight Pendants in Darnassus as proof that the Twilight's Hammer in Blackfathom Deeps is being struck down before its plans can mature.

aliases: where do twilight pendants come from
faq.answer: Twilight Acolytes, Aquamancers, Shadowmages, Loreseekers, Elementalists, and Reavers wear these pendants inside Blackfathom Deeps.

faq.q: What threat does the Twilight's Hammer pose in Blackfathom Deeps?
aliases: what is twilights hammer doing in bfd
faq.answer: The Twilight's Hammer allies with the naga to revive worship of the Old Gods. Its rites desecrate an ancient night elf moonwell and could spread terror across Kalimdor.

angles.text: As a night elf, you know Blackfathom Deeps once held a revered and powerful moonwell. Reclaiming its symbols of corruption is a matter of deep sanctity for the kaldorei.
As an Alliance member, you can bring these trophies to Argent Guard Manados in Darnassus. They show the Alliance's support for the Argent Dawn's campaign against hidden evils in northern Kalimdor.
